The MG limit blocker from T0040 is REMOVED (GMIO works); the new blocker is downstream in the chess scheduler.
v1_1a_followup_paths: Path A (recommended): rewrite kernel_av Stage 5 inner loop using aie::mac with v32int8 intrinsics. This both fixes the scheduler issue (vector ops have known optimal schedules) and likely improves the achievable latency by ~30x. Requires ~1 day of intrinsic-tuning work.

Path B: split kernel_av further — kernel_av_mac runs per V row (NTOK invocations via runtime ratio), kernel_av_sat reads acc + emits output once. Each sub-kernel is small enough for the scheduler. ~half-day refactor.
Path C: tile acc[QDIM] into 4 sub-tiles of 1024 each, process sequentially within one kernel call. Each tile's inner loop is small. No vector intrinsics needed.
